job.title: Head of Talent Management and Development | Manufacturing | 15M
job.description:
1. IDEC Corporation – Head of Talent Management and Development
  2. FBI (Feature, Benefit, Incentive)

English

I wanted to chat with you about an opportunity to lead IDEC's global talent management and human resource development strategy.

You’d shape the company's leadership pipeline, succession planning, talent development and recruitment strategy, while building a global talent management framework aligned with business objectives.

It’s a strategic leadership opportunity to develop the next generation of global leaders and transform how IDEC attracts, develops and retains talent.

日本語

IDECのグローバル人材戦略と人材開発を統括するポジションです。

次世代リーダー育成や後継者計画、採用・人材開発制度を構築できます。

グローバル企業への変革を人材面から主導する戦略的な機会です。

2. Role Overview / ポジション概要

Item Details

Company / 企業名 IDEC Corporation / IDEC株式会社

Title / 職位 Head of Talent Management and Development / 人材マネジメント・人材開発責任者

Position Title / 求人票上の職位 Manager, Talent Development / 人材開発課長

Location / 勤務地 Osaka Headquarters, Nishimiyahara, Yodogawa-ku, Osaka / 大阪本社（大阪市淀川区西宮原）

Work Style / 勤務形態 Not specified in the job description / 求人票に記載なし

Working Hours / 勤務時間 8:30–17:15 (1-hour break) / 8:30～17:15（休憩1時間）

Employment Type / 雇用形態 Regular employee or renewable specialist employment contract up to age 65 / 正社員または65歳まで更新可能な専門職契約

Language Requirements / 語学要件 Business-level English; TOEIC 850 or equivalent / ビジネスレベルの英語力、TOEIC 850点相当以上

Reporting Line / レポートライン Head of Human Resources & General Affairs / 人事総務部門責任者

Team Size / 部下の人数 Approximately 6 direct reports, with potential future expansion / 約6名（今後拡大の可能性あり）

Compensation / 年収 JPY 10M–15M (manager-level position; negotiable based on experience and current compensation) / 1,000万～1,500万円（経験・能力・現年収を考慮）

Employment Structure / 雇用形態の補足

  • Regular Employee: Mandatory retirement at 60, followed by a renewable reemployment arrangement. Compensation generally becomes approximately 70–80% of the pre-retirement level.
  • Specialist Contract: Renewable annually until age 65, with no retirement-related loss of position or salary reduction at age 60.
  • 正社員：60歳定年。定年後は再雇用制度へ移行し、年収は原則として定年前の約70～80％。
  • 専門職契約：65歳まで1年ごとの契約更新が可能。60歳到達時の役職喪失や給与減額なし。

3. Mission & Scope / ミッション・業務範囲

English

  • Develop and implement a global talent management framework covering Japan and overseas operations.
  • Formulate talent strategies aligned with IDEC's medium- to long-term business plans.
  • Lead talent portfolio development and human capital investment planning.
  • Oversee graduate and mid-career recruitment (approximately 50 hires annually).
  • Design and implement leadership development and next-generation management talent programs.
  • Establish succession planning and high-potential talent development processes.
  • Lead employee training, career development, assessment and talent review programs.
  • Analyze high performers, employee engagement and turnover risks.
  • Develop global mobility training, cross-cultural education and language development programs.
  • Strengthen onboarding, employee retention and engagement initiatives.
  • Lead and develop the Talent Development team.

日本語

  • 国内外を対象としたグローバルタレントマネジメント基盤の構築・運用
  • 中長期経営計画と連動した人材戦略の策定
  • 人材ポートフォリオの構築および人的資本投資計画の策定
  • 新卒・中途採用の統括（年間約50名）
  • 次世代経営人材・リーダー育成プログラムの企画・実行
  • 後継者計画およびハイポテンシャル人材育成の仕組みづくり
  • 社員研修、キャリア開発、各種アセスメント・タレントレビューの統括
  • ハイパフォーマー分析、エンゲージメント分析、離職リスク分析
  • 海外赴任前研修、異文化理解研修、語学教育プログラムの企画・運営
  • オンボーディング、従業員定着・エンゲージメント施策の強化
  • 人材開発チームのマネジメント・組織強化

4. Key Objectives / 主要目標

English

By FY2028:

  • Establish a global talent management framework.
  • Launch a next-generation management and leadership development program.
  • Strengthen talent acquisition capabilities and recruitment strategy.
  • Establish and operationalize succession planning processes.
  • Develop global common competency frameworks.
  • Modernize leadership and employee development programs to address the DX and AI era.

日本語

2028年度までに以下を実現することが期待されています。

  • グローバルタレントマネジメント基盤の構築
  • 次世代経営人材・リーダー育成プログラムの導入
  • 採用機能および人材獲得戦略の強化
  • 後継者計画の策定および運用開始
  • グローバル共通コンピテンシーの策定
  • DX・AI時代に対応した階層別教育・人材育成体系の改革

5. Ideal Profile / 求める人物像

Must-Have / 必須要件

  • 10+ years of experience in human resource development within a corporate environment.
  • 5+ years of leadership or managerial experience in talent development.
  • Experience designing and implementing talent management systems.
  • Experience building comprehensive leadership and employee development frameworks.
  • Expertise in learning and development program design.
  • Ability to influence and advise senior executives.
  • Strong project management and presentation skills.
  • Data analytics and data-driven decision-making capabilities.
  • Business-level English proficiency (TOEIC 850 or equivalent).

必須要件（日本語）

  • 事業会社における人材開発経験10年以上
  • 人材開発部門の責任者またはマネジメント経験5年以上
  • タレントマネジメントシステムの構築経験
  • 階層別教育・人材育成体系の構築経験
  • 人材開発・研修プログラムの設計能力
  • 経営層への提案・アドバイザリー能力
  • プロジェクトマネジメントおよびプレゼンテーション能力
  • データ分析・データに基づく意思決定能力
  • ビジネスレベルの英語力（TOEIC 850点相当以上）

Preferred / 歓迎要件

  • Experience working for a global organization.
  • Overseas assignment or expatriate experience.
  • Professional coaching certification.
  • Career consulting certification.

歓迎要件（日本語）

  • グローバル企業での勤務経験
  • 海外赴任・駐在経験
  • コーチング関連資格
  • キャリアコンサルタント資格

6. Interview Process / 選考プロセス

English

The specific interview stages and interviewers have not been provided in the job description.

日本語

具体的な選考回数・面接ステージ・面接官については、求人票に記載がありません。企業への確認が必要です。

job.title: Head of HR/GA | Manufacturing | 20M
job.description:
Title

Head of Global Human Resources

Salary

JPY 15,000,000 - 20,000,000 annually, negotiable based on experience, expertise, and current compensation.

Location

Osaka, Japan

Reports To

Head of Human Resources & Corporate Services

About the Company

Our client is a global industrial and technology-oriented organization with operations across multiple international markets. As part of its next stage of growth, the company is undertaking a significant transformation of its global people strategy, governance framework, and human capital infrastructure to support a more integrated worldwide organization.

About the Role

This is a senior HR leadership opportunity responsible for driving the organization's global human resources transformation agenda. The role will lead the design and implementation of consistent HR strategies, governance models, compensation frameworks, performance management systems, and talent infrastructure across international operations.

Working closely with executive leadership and regional HR stakeholders, the successful candidate will play a critical role in building a globally aligned HR function while supporting business growth, organizational effectiveness, and leadership capability across multiple regions.

This position offers the opportunity to influence enterprise-wide transformation and may provide a pathway to broader leadership responsibilities within the HR organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the organization's global HR strategy and operating model.
  • Establish global HR governance structures, policies, standards, and best practices across international locations.
  • Lead the transformation of compensation, grading, and performance management frameworks on a global scale.
  • Design and implement global competency models and support talent management and succession planning initiatives.
  • Partner with HR and business leaders across Europe, the Americas, Greater China, and Asia-Pacific markets to ensure alignment and governance.
  • Review and modernize international assignment, mobility, expatriate, and global rewards programs.
  • Support executive recruitment and strategic hiring initiatives for critical leadership positions.
  • Drive workforce planning and strategic human capital initiatives aligned with business objectives.
  • Lead the development of a global talent database and integrated people management infrastructure.
  • Build stronger alignment among regional HR teams through a matrix-based governance approach.
  • Lead, develop, and expand the global HR team, including organizational capability building and succession planning.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives on workforce strategy, organizational design, and people-related transformation initiatives.

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years of experience in a corporate HR environment, including responsibility for global HR activities.
  • 10+ years of leadership or management experience within an HR organization.
  • Demonstrated success leading HR transformation, organizational change, or performance management reform initiatives.
  • Experience collaborating with international stakeholders and geographically dispersed business units.
  • Strong expertise in the design and implementation of global HR frameworks and systems.
  • Experience developing compensation, rewards, grading, and performance management programs.
  • Strategic workforce planning and human capital management experience.
  • Strong executive stakeholder management, organizational leadership, and project management capabilities.
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and influencing skills.
  • Business-level English proficiency (approximately TOEIC 850 or equivalent).

Preferred

  • Experience in the corporate headquarters of a multinational organization.
  • International assignment, expatriate, or overseas leadership experience.
  • HR Business Partner (HRBP) experience supporting senior business leaders.
  • Post-merger integration (PMI) or organizational integration experience following international acquisitions.
  • Experience leading digital transformation or HR technology initiatives.
  • Experience integrating global HR systems, governance models, and talent processes across multiple regions.
  • Familiarity with global mobility, international rewards, and cross-border workforce management practices.

Why Join?

  • Lead a high-impact global HR transformation within an internationally expanding organization.
  • Shape enterprise-wide HR strategy, governance, talent infrastructure, and people processes.
  • Partner directly with executive leadership to influence long-term business success.
  • Play a central role in building a unified global culture and operating model across multiple regions.
  • Drive the modernization of compensation, performance management, and workforce planning practices.
  • Lead and grow a global HR team while creating sustainable organizational capability.
  • Competitive executive-level compensation with flexibility based on experience and expertise.
  • Choice of regular employment or renewable specialist contract arrangements, subject to company policy and eligibility.

job.title: Senior HR Manager | Tech | 18M
job.description:
Title

Senior Manager, Human Resources - Japan

Salary

Competitive base salary, annual bonus, and long-term equity incentives

Location

Osaka, Japan (primarily onsite across corporate and manufacturing locations)

Reports To

APAC Human Resources Director

About the Company

Our client is a global technology and advanced manufacturing company with a significant workforce in Japan and a strong presence across the Asia-Pacific region. The organization is undergoing a transformation focused on employee engagement, leadership development, organizational effectiveness, and talent growth.

About the Role

This is a senior HR leadership position responsible for leading the Human Resources function across Japan. The role supports a large employee population spanning manufacturing, engineering, research and development, and commercial teams.

The successful candidate will serve as the primary HR advisor to senior business leaders, lead a small HR team, and drive initiatives related to employee engagement, talent development, succession planning, organizational effectiveness, and culture transformation. This role offers the opportunity to influence business strategy while helping build a more people-centered and performance-oriented organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead all HR activities for approximately 800 employees across Japan.
  • Partner with local business leaders to align people strategies with business objectives.
  • Act as the primary HR advisor for workforce planning, organizational design, employee relations, and change management initiatives.
  • Drive employee engagement programs and foster a positive, inclusive workplace culture.
  • Build and strengthen leadership development and succession planning frameworks.
  • Support organizational transformation efforts and help leaders navigate change effectively.
  • Translate global HR programs and policies into locally relevant solutions.
  • Champion performance management, talent development, and workforce capability-building initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with Japanese labor laws, employment regulations, and HR governance requirements.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of HR professionals while collaborating closely with talent acquisition, payroll, and other support functions.
  • Maintain constructive relationships with employee representatives and labor organizations where applicable.
  • Increase HR visibility throughout the workforce by fostering strong relationships with employees and site leadership.

Qualifications

Required

  • Significant Human Resources leadership experience within Japan.
  • Strong knowledge of Japanese labor law, employment practices, compliance requirements, and employee relations.

Why Join?

  • Take ownership of the HR function for a large and strategically important workforce in Japan.
  • Partner directly with senior business leaders and regional HR leadership.
  • Play a key role in shaping culture, engagement, talent development, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Lead meaningful transformation initiatives within a growing global organization.
  • Work with diverse teams across manufacturing, engineering, and commercial operations.
  • Relocation support is available for candidates moving to Osaka.
  • Opportunity for future growth into broader regional HR leadership responsibilities within the Asia-Pacific region.
  • Competitive compensation package including bonus and long-term incentives.

job.title: Head of HR| Automotive | 18M
job.description:
Title

Head of Human Resources

Salary

Approximately ¥15M base salary, depending on experience, plus 20% target bonus.

Location

Tokyo, Japan

Primarily office-based, with 1 day per week working from home and flex-time available.

Employment type: To be confirmed

Target start: Q1 2027, to be confirmed

Reports To

President & CEO, Japan

The role also has a functional reporting relationship to the global HR organization in Europe and serves as a member of the local Executive Committee.

About the Company

Our client is the Japanese subsidiary of a globally recognized European premium automotive brand.

With approximately 90 employees in Japan, the organization combines the scale, standards and international reach of a global group with a lean local structure. The Japan business works closely with its European headquarters while adapting global priorities to the needs of the local market.

About the Role

This is the senior HR leadership position for Japan, with ownership of the full people and organization agenda.

Reporting directly to the President & CEO and participating in the Executive Committee, the Head of Human Resources will act as a strategic advisor to senior leadership while remaining closely involved in day-to-day HR execution.

The successful candidate will lead workforce strategy, organizational change, talent, compensation and benefits, employee relations, labor and compliance, development, global mobility and HR operations.

The role will also act as an important bridge between Japan and the company's European headquarters, translating global HR priorities and frameworks into practical, locally appropriate solutions.

The HR function operates with a lean structure consisting of the HR Head, an HR Specialist and temporary HR support, so this position requires someone equally comfortable discussing organization strategy with executive leadership and handling hands-on HR matters.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and lead the end-to-end HR agenda for the Japan organization.
  • Act as a strategic people advisor to the President & CEO and Executive Committee.
  • Develop and implement people strategies aligned with local business priorities and the organization's long-term global strategy.
  • Lead workforce planning and organizational effectiveness initiatives, including appropriate workforce efficiency and cost-optimization measures.
  • Strengthen succession planning, talent management, employee development, engagement and retention.
  • Oversee compensation and benefits, employee relations, labor matters, HR compliance, global mobility and HR operations.
  • Ensure HR practices are consistent with Japanese employment requirements while appropriately implementing global policies and frameworks.
  • Partner closely with global and regional HR stakeholders, ensuring effective communication between Japan and European headquarters.
  • Identify organizational and people risks and provide practical, commercially minded recommendations to leadership.
  • Lead and support organizational transformation and change initiatives.
  • Provide both strategic leadership and hands-on HRBP support within a lean local HR organization.
  • Build trusted relationships across the business and foster an effective, high-performing organization.

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years of progressive HR experience, with approximately 3–5+ years in a Head of HR, HR Director, senior HRBP or comparable leadership position.
  • Broad HR generalist expertise spanning the employee lifecycle.
  • Experience working within a multinational or foreign-affiliated organization.
  • Strong understanding of Japanese employment practices, labor requirements and HR operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise CEO and executive-level stakeholders on organization and people topics.
  • Ability and willingness to combine strategic HR leadership with hands-on execution.
  • Strong business judgment, integrity and executive-level communication skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively within a lean organization and manage competing priorities.
  • Native-level Japanese and business-level English, with the ability to communicate effectively with both local and international stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Experience within a European-headquartered multinational organization.
  • Experience adapting and implementing global HR frameworks within Japan.
  • Experience in automotive, premium consumer/luxury, manufacturing or related industrial environments.
  • Exposure to organizational transformation, restructuring, workforce optimization or cost-efficiency initiatives.
  • German-language capability.

Why Join?

This is a rare opportunity to take full ownership of the HR agenda for the Japanese business of a high-profile global premium automotive organization.

The position offers direct access to the President & CEO, membership of the Executive Committee and significant visibility with global headquarters. Rather than operating within a large, highly segmented HR structure, you will have the opportunity to influence decisions across the entire people agenda, from workforce strategy and organizational transformation through to talent, employee relations and HR operations.

For an experienced HR leader who enjoys being strategic but genuinely hands-on, the role offers an unusual combination of executive influence, international exposure and end-to-end ownership.

job.title: Legal Counsel | Insurance | 18.5M
job.description:
グローバルに事業を展開する金融サービス・保険企業において、法務担当として事業部門やコーポレート部門と連携しながら、日常的な法律相談対応、契約審査、紛争対応、プロジェクト支援など幅広い法務業務を担当いただきます。ビジネスの推進とリスク管理の両立を図りながら、実務的かつ戦略的な法務支援を提供するポジションです。

主な業務内容

1. 法務相談・リーガルアドバイス

  • 社内各部門から寄せられる法律相談への対応
  • 契約、規制対応、個人情報保護、消費者対応、紛争予防などに関する法的助言
  • 法的リスクの分析および解決策の提案
  • 外部法律事務所への相談要否の判断および外部弁護士との連携・案件マネジメント

job.title: Chief Compliance Officer | Private Equity | 30M
job.description:
日本全国の企業に対するエクイティ投資を主な事業としている会社です。特に地域企業を中心に、多様な資金ニーズに対応しながら成長資金を提供し、投資先の中長期的な企業価値向上を支援しています。これにより、個別企業の成長だけでなく、地域経済および日本経済全体の活性化への貢献を目指しています。

また、地域金融機関や外部パートナーと連携し、「共創プラットフォーム」を構築しています。この枠組みを通じて、資金提供にとどまらず、経営支援やネットワークの活用など、総合的なサポートを提供しています。企業の課題解決と持続的な成長を後押しする点が特徴です。投資を軸としたビジネスモデルを展開しつつ、投資先企業との長期的なパートナーシップを重視することで、持続可能な成長と社会的価値の創出を実現することを目指しています。

1. コンプライアンス業務の統括

プライベートエクイティファンド運営会社におけるコンプライアンス機能全般をリードしていただきます。具体的には、コンプライアンス体制の構築・高度化（委員会運営を含む）、関連法規の改正への対応、反社会的勢力対応やAML/CFT/CFPに関する管理、顧客情報および投資関連情報の管理を担います。さらに、利益相反の管理や各種コンプライアンスチェック、社内向け研修・教育の企画・実施、内部規程の整備・更新・運用にも関与していただきます。加えて、親会社との各種調整や資料対応、ならびに監督官庁（関東財務局等）への対応も担当範囲に含まれます。

2. 投資案件に関するリスク対応支援

主にバイアウト案件を中心とした投資プロジェクトについて、コンプライアンスおよびレピュテーションリスクの観点から分析を行い、投資担当部門に対して適切な助言・支援を提供します。案件ごとの潜在リスクを踏まえた意思決定を後押しする役割を担います。
